mapper.select: /* 상품과 이미지 조회 */ SELECT p.pno, pname, pdesc, price, sale, writer, p.regdate, ino, uuid, filename, ord FROM tbl_product AS p LEFT OUTER JOIN tbl_product_image AS pimg ON p.pno = pimg.pno WHERE 1 = 1 AND p.pno = #{pno} ORDER BY pimg.ord
mapper.update: /* 상품 삭제 */ UPDATE tbl_product SET sale = FALSE WHERE 1 = 1 AND pno = #{pno}
mapper.select: /* 상품목록 조회 */ SELECT p.pno AS pno, p.pname AS pname, p.pdesc AS pdesc, p.price AS price, p.sale AS sale, p.writer AS writer, p.regdate AS regdate, i.ino AS ino, i.uuid AS uuid, i.filename AS filename, i.ord AS ord FROM tbl_product AS p LEFT OUTER JOIN tbl_product_image AS i ON p.pno = i.pno WHERE 1 = 1 AND i.ord = 0 ORDER BY p.pno DESC LIMIT #{count} OFFSET #{skip}
